grist-widget-sdk.name: checkGristCell
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Checks one value against a Grist column type (`"Numeric"`, `"Ref:People"`, `"Text,Ref"`), as typed reads do: the value the type promises, or why it doesn't fit.
signatures: checkGristCell(type: string | undefined, value: unknown): GristCellCheck

grist-widget-sdk.name: decodeGristValue
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Decodes a Grist cell value into an idiomatic JS value.

grist-widget-sdk.name: defineGristWidget
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Declares a widget. The `const` type parameter keeps the column names and types literal, so the mapped record is typed with no annotation, no `as const` and no generics.
signatures: defineGristWidget<const D extends GristWidgetDefinition>(definition: D): GristWidget<D>

grist-widget-sdk.name: encodeGristCell
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A value as Grist stores it in a column of the declared `type`: the reverse of what typed reads give. Lists become `["L", ...]` (a RefList's `Reference` items become their row ids), a `Date` for a Date or DateTime column becomes seconds since the epoch, a `Reference` for a Ref column its row id. A list already encoded (`["L", ...]`, as the attachment helpers return it) and every other value pass through, so it is safe to call twice.
signatures: encodeGristCell(type: string | undefined, value: unknown): unknown

grist-widget-sdk.name: encodeGristValue
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Encodes a JS value into Grist's expected wire form for a given column type.

grist-widget-sdk.name: extractGristAttachmentId
grist-widget-sdk.summary: First attachment id in the cell, if any (see `extractGristAttachmentIdsFromCell`).

grist-widget-sdk.name: extractGristAttachmentIdsFromCell
grist-widget-sdk.summary: All attachment ids found in a Grist attachment cell value (ordered, deduped). Attachment columns are usually an **array** of file refs; a single id or one JSON object is also supported.

grist-widget-sdk.name: FetchRows
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A table's rows, each `{ id, ...cells }` under real column ids. Without a table id, the widget's own table as its section shows it (filters and sort applied); with one, any table (full access), in Grist's row order. `{ columnar: true }` gives Grist's columns instead.

grist-widget-sdk.name: FetchRowsOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: `fetchRows()` options: rows (the default) or Grist's columns.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristApi
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The methods `useGrist()` returns next to its state: reads, writes, attachments and the cursor.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristApplyUserActionsOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Optional second argument to `docApi.applyUserActions`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: gristAttachmentCellValue
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Wire value for a single-file Attachments cell.

grist-widget-sdk.name: gristAttachmentCellValues
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Wire value for an Attachments cell (Grist list encoding).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristAttachmentUploadResult
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The attachment ids an upload created.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristBoundary
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Renders the widget once Grist is connected, has granted the access it declares, and every required declared column is mapped; until then, a screen that says what is missing (with a retry where one can help). Requires `<GristWidgetProvider>`; `mountGristWidget()` renders both.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristBoundaryProps
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The widget, shown once it is connected, has its access and its required columns mapped.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristCellCheck
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What `checkGristCell` returns: the cell's value, or why it doesn't match its declared type.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristCellIssue
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A mapped cell that didn't match its declared type, or a rule of the widget's schema.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristChoiceListEntry
grist-widget-sdk.summary: One selectable choice for UI (value stored in the cell is `value`).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristColumnarTable
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Column-oriented table payload, as Grist's `grist.docApi.fetchTable` and `grist.fetchSelectedTable` send it: `{ id: [...], Name: [...] }`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristColumnExcludeContext
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What `extraExcludeColumn` is given for each column.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristColumnInfo
grist-widget-sdk.summary: One column of a table, as `listColumns()` gives it.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristColumnsToMap
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Argument shape for `grist.ready({ columns })`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristColumnToMap
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Single-column declaration in `grist.ready({ columns })`. Mirrors Grist `ColumnToMap`. See https://support.getgrist.com/code/interfaces/grist_plugin_api.ColumnToMap/

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristCursorPos
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Argument to `grist.setCursorPos` (subset of Grist `CursorPos`).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristDecodedValue
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A cell as `decodeGristValue` returns it: plain values, `Date`s and lists, or an error or a reference marker.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristDocumentMode
grist-widget-sdk.summary: How row bodies were populated when the replica document was built (hint only). Loaders should still treat omitted `rows` like `[]` via `normalizeReplicaTableInput`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristEncodedAttachmentList
grist-widget-sdk.summary: An Attachments cell as Grist writes it: `["L", ...ids]`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristEncodedError
grist-widget-sdk.summary: `["E", "ErrorClass", "message", traceback?]` — Grist error sentinel.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristFetchedAttachmentBlob
grist-widget-sdk.summary: An attachment's bytes, and their content type.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristFetchSelectedOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Options for Grist's own `grist.fetchSelectedTable` / `grist.fetchSelectedRecord` (GristView).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristFormulaKind
grist-widget-sdk.summary: How Grist treats the column (from `_grist_Tables_column` `isFormula` + `formula`). `empty_slot` is Grist's "empty column" state: `isFormula` true with no formula text.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristMappedRow
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The mapped record a declaration's columns give: `{ id }` and each declared column, typed from its Grist type. `widget.useGrist()` uses it, and `GristWidgetRow<typeof widget>` names it for a component's props.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristMinimalRecord
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The least a record has: its row id.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristNoiseColumnsOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Which of Grist's bookkeeping columns to leave out: the row id, helper columns, logging columns, `manualSort`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristReadyOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Arguments accepted by `grist.ready` for custom widgets.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristRecordPatch
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A write under declared names: any of the mapped record's fields but its `id`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristReplicaColumn
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Column metadata in replica JSON: Grist-native fields only (no samples / scan stats). `formulaKind` is optional UI convenience; use `resolveGristFormulaKind` when missing.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristReplicaDocument
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Canonical Grist replica document: one JSON type for `getDocumentJson`, fixtures, and `createGristEmulator({ document })`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristReplicaRow
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Decoded row in replica JSON (`id` + fields). Same as wire `fetchTable` row objects, but **not** columnar `Record<colId, unknown[]>` — that shape is only on `docApi.fetchTable`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristReplicaSelection
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Selection slice persisted on replica fixtures (emulator / widget).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristReplicaTable
grist-widget-sdk.summary: One table of a replica document: its columns and, optionally, its rows.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristRequiredAccess
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Access level passed to `grist.ready({ requiredAccess })`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristRowRecord
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A row from `grist.onRecord` or `fetchTable`. Always carries a numeric `id`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristSchemaTableView
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Selected table slice with `tableId` for consumers that expect it on the object.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristSdkAlertKind
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The alerts `mountGristWidget()` shows above a running widget: what needs the user's attention in Grist (column mapping, access, a failed write, an unlinked section). The blocking states (not connected, access refused, required columns unmapped) are `<GristBoundary>`'s, not alerts.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristTableNewRecord
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Record for `create` (no id needed).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristTableOperations
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Wraps `grist.getTable(...)` / `grist.selectedTable`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristTableOpOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Options accepted by `TableOperations.create / update`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristTableUpdateRecord
grist-widget-sdk.summary: `TableOperations`-style record for `update`. Must include `id`; other fields are partial.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristTableUpsertOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Options accepted by `TableOperations.upsert`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristTableUpsertRecord
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Record for `upsert`: `require` is the match key set, `fields` is what to write.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristTheme
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The widget's connection to Grist: one store, one `connect()`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristUserActionTuple
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Grist `docApi.applyUserActions` payloads are arrays of user-action tuples.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidget
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A declared widget. Pass it to `mountGristWidget()` (as `widget`, exported from `src/app/App.tsx`).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetActionStatus
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A write's status: none running, one running, or the last one failed (`actionError` says why).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetColumnMap
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Mapping returned by Grist between logical widget column names and real table column ids. Single mappings are `string`; `allowMultiple` columns are `string[]`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetConfiguration
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Last `grist.ready` options mirrored with the emulator (optional on fixtures).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetDefinition
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What a widget declares: `UseGristOptions`, plus its title, description and where to report a problem.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetDemo
grist-widget-sdk.summary: A widget's demo data (`src/app/demo.ts`, exported as `demo`): the document its demo page, its real-Grist check and `create-grist-widget demo` open, in place of generated sample rows. The demo page is public: invented data only, and never a key in its options.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetDemoColumnType
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The column types demo data takes.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetInteraction
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Second argument to `grist.onOptions` — document ↔ widget relationship (subset of Grist `InteractionOptions`).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetLinkingInfo
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Linking state reported by Grist in `onOptions` settings (`InteractionOptions.linking`).

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetMetadata
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What describes a widget rather than configures it: its title, description and report URL.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetMode
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Derived from the selection: no row, a row, or the add-row placeholder.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetProvider
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Connects to Grist for the widgets below it: `useGrist()` under it reads this connection. `mountGristWidget()` renders it; render it yourself only for a page that manages its own React root.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetProviderProps
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What the provider connects with, and the widgets below it.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetRow
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The widget's mapped record type, from its declaration.

grist-widget-sdk.name: GristWidgetStatus
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The widget's connection to Grist, as `useGrist().status` reports it.

grist-widget-sdk.name: httpUrl
grist-widget-sdk.summary: `value` as a URL a widget may link to or load from: an absolute `http:` or `https:` URL, normalised, or `undefined`. Use it on every link or source that comes from a document's data, before it reaches an `href` or a `src`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: isGristCellError
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Convenience: true when the cell is a Grist error sentinel.

grist-widget-sdk.name: ListColumnsOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: `listColumns()`'s options: which columns to leave out.

grist-widget-sdk.name: ListTablesOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: `useGrist()`'s methods, created once per runtime: every one is referentially stable for the widget's lifetime, and reads `grist` when called (the emulator installs and removes it in tests).

grist-widget-sdk.name: mergeGristAttachmentCellValue
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Merge new attachment ids into an existing Attachments cell value (deduped, order preserved).

grist-widget-sdk.name: MigrateWidgetOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Brings options written under `fromVersion` (lower than the widget's `optionsVersion`) to the current version. Return a new plain object; options it can't migrate: throw, and they are left as they are. Check the options' shape rather than trust `fromVersion` alone: options without a version count as version 1, and may already be in a later shape.

grist-widget-sdk.name: normalizeGristChoiceListEntries
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Normalizes Grist Choice / ChoiceList widgetOptions into a flat list for dropdowns. `choices` entries are string labels (the stored cell value). Per-choice styling lives in `choiceOptions[label]`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: ReplicaDocumentJsonOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Options for `getDocumentJson` / `buildDocumentJson` on the return value of `useGristSchema`.

grist-widget-sdk.name: resolveGristFormulaKind
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Use when `formulaKind` may be missing (e.g. older document builds).

grist-widget-sdk.name: StandardSchema
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Minimal Standard Schema (https://standardschema.dev): zod 4, valibot, arktype implement it.

grist-widget-sdk.name: tableDataToRows
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Turn `fetchTable` output into row objects (order follows the `id` column).

grist-widget-sdk.name: useGrist
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The widget's Grist state and API, from the nearest `<GristWidgetProvider>`: `mountGristWidget()` renders one inside Grist, and `renderWithGrist(<App />, { widget })` in a test. Throws outside one; a component that also runs outside Grist calls `useGristOptional()`.
signatures: useGrist<TRow = Record<string, unknown>, TMapped = Record<string, unknown>>(): UseGristResult<TRow, TMapped>

grist-widget-sdk.name: useGristOptional
grist-widget-sdk.summary: `useGrist()` inside a provider, or null outside one: for components that also work without Grist.
signatures: useGristOptional<TRow = Record<string, unknown>, TMapped = Record<string, unknown>>(): UseGristResult<TRow, TMapped> | null

grist-widget-sdk.name: UseGristOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What the widget asks Grist for: access, columns to map, and the alerts it doesn't want.

grist-widget-sdk.name: UseGristResult
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The widget's Grist state and API. Every method is referentially stable for the widget's lifetime: safe in effect dependencies. The object itself is new whenever a value changes; depend on the members you use, not on it.

grist-widget-sdk.name: useGristSchema
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Grist replica-document hook: metadata + optional decoded `rows` per table.

grist-widget-sdk.name: UseGristSchemaOptions
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What `useGristSchema` reads. The connection (access level, columns) is the widget's declaration, from `defineGristWidget()`: the hook reads it through the provider `mountGristWidget()` renders.

grist-widget-sdk.name: UseGristSchemaResult
grist-widget-sdk.summary: What `useGristSchema()` returns: the document as a replica, and its JSON.

grist-widget-sdk.name: useWidgetMetadata
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Sets the page's title and its description meta tags (Open Graph and Twitter included) when the component mounts and whenever `input` changes; nothing is restored on unmount. `mountGristWidget()` does this from the declaration's title and description.

grist-widget-sdk.name: UseWidgetMetadataInput
grist-widget-sdk.summary: The page's title and description.

grist-widget-sdk.name: ValidateColumnMappingsResult
grist-widget-sdk.summary: Whether the declared columns are mapped: what is missing, and whether Grist has sent the mappings yet.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: DeployChannel
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: Where a deployed build is being served from.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: DeployPath
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: A served URL's channel, and the base path its channels share: what `parseDeployPath` returns.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: entryProps
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: The props `GristWidgetApp` takes, from a widget's entry module.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: GristWidgetApp
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: The tree `mountGristWidget` renders, as a component: for a test, or for a page that manages its own React root.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: GristWidgetAppProps
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: What renders a widget: the component, what it asks Grist for, and the pages and alerts around it.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: GristWidgetEntry
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: A widget's entry module, `src/app/App.tsx`, as `import * as entry` gives it: the widget as its default export, its declaration as `widget`, and optionally its own `Alerts`, `LocalDevPage` and `ReleasePage`.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: MountedGristWidget
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: A mounted widget: `unmount()` removes it and its React root.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: mountGristWidget
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: Render a widget into the page: everything `src/main.tsx` used to wire by hand.
signatures: mountGristWidget(entry: GristWidgetEntry, options?: { dev?: boolean; root?: Element | string; }): MountedGristWidget

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: MountGristWidgetConfig
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: `mountGristWidget()`'s older form: the widget's props, and where to render.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: parseDeployPath
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: Parse a pathname into its deploy channel and base path. A path without a channel segment (the deployed root, or a local dev server) is `latest`: the deploy places the latest release at the root too.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: ReleasedVersion
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: One entry of the `versions.json` a widget's deploy pipeline maintains.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: ResolvedWidgetTheme
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: The theme applied: `"system"` resolved to light or dark.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: useReleasedVersions
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: The widget's released versions, read from the `versions.json` next to its channels (see `parseDeployPath`). For a page shown outside Grist, such as a release page linking to each version.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: useTheme
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: The widget's current theme, for components that need it in JavaScript (a toaster, a chart). Same shape as shadcn's `useTheme()`. Styles should rely on the `dark` class that `mountGristWidget` keeps on `<html>`. Outside a mounted widget (a unit test, for instance) it reports the system theme and `setTheme` does nothing.

grist-widget-sdk/app.name: WidgetTheme
grist-widget-sdk/app.summary: A theme choice: light, dark, or the system's.

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristAddColumnAction
grist-widget-sdk/actions.summary: `["AddColumn", tableId, colId, colInfo]` — `colInfo` shape depends on Grist version / column type.
signatures: gristAddColumnAction(tableId: string, colId: string, colInfo: Record<string, unknown>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristAddRecordAction
signatures: gristAddRecordAction(tableId: string, values: Record<string, unknown>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristAddTableAction
signatures: gristAddTableAction(tableId: string, tableInfo: Record<string, unknown>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristAddVisibleColumnAction
grist-widget-sdk/actions.summary: `["AddVisibleColumn", tableId, colId, colInfo]` — like `AddColumn` but also adds the column to the current view section.
signatures: gristAddVisibleColumnAction(tableId: string, colId: string, colInfo: Record<string, unknown>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristBulkAddRecordAction
grist-widget-sdk/actions.summary: `["BulkAddRecord", tableId, rowIds | nullArray, { col: value[], ... }]`. Pass `null` (or omit) for `rowIds` to let Grist allocate ids; in user-action format Grist expects an array of nulls of the same length as the value arrays.
signatures: gristBulkAddRecordAction(tableId: string, values: Record<string, unknown[]>, rowIds?: Array<number | null>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristBulkUpdateRecordAction
signatures: gristBulkUpdateRecordAction(tableId: string, rowIds: number[], columnarPatch: Record<string, unknown[]>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristModifyColumnAction
signatures: gristModifyColumnAction(tableId: string, colId: string, colInfo: Record<string, unknown>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristRenameColumnAction
signatures: gristRenameColumnAction(tableId: string, colId: string, newColId: string): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: gristUpdateRecordAction
signatures: gristUpdateRecordAction(tableId: string, rowId: number, patch: Record<string, unknown>): GristUserActionTuple

grist-widget-sdk/actions.name: GristUserActionTuple
grist-widget-sdk/actions.summary: Grist `docApi.applyUserActions` payloads are arrays of user-action tuples.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: CreateDocumentInput
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Replica document for `createDocument`; widens table columns to `EmulatorColumn`.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: CreateDocumentTableInput
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Replica table for `createDocument`; columns may include `formulaFn` / `inferredFormula` (emulator-only).

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: createGristEmulator
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Creates an emulator for a replica document: it checks the document, installs the `grist` global (inline transport) and answers the widget as Grist does. Tests usually go through `renderWithGrist()`.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: CreateGristEmulatorOptions
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Top-level emulator factory. Produces a fully-wired emulator instance:

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorActionError
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: A user action the emulator could not apply (a missing row, an action it does not support): the action, and why.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorApiBundle
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Bundles the six host-side Grist API implementations into one record so inline transport can wire them up.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorColumn
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Column metadata for the emulator: `GristReplicaColumn` plus in-process `formulaFn` (never serialized in replica JSON).

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorDocumentState
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: The emulator's document: its tables, the widget's selection and options.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorEvent
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Tiny pub-sub used to broadcast every emulator state change to: - the transports (which translate events into protocol messages), - the React DevTools inspector (timeline view), - the testing harness (assertions on emitted events).

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorRowId
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Core types for the in-memory Grist emulator document model.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorTable
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: One table of the emulator's document: its columns and rows.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: EmulatorTransport
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: How the emulator reaches the widget: pushes Grist's events to it.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: enrichEmulatorColumnMetadata
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Ensure `formula` (original) and `inferredFormula` strings exist alongside optional `formulaFn`.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: GristEmulator
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: An in-memory Grist document and the `grist` global a widget reads it through.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: GristReplicaDocument
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Canonical Grist replica document: one JSON type for `getDocumentJson`, fixtures, and `createGristEmulator({ document })`.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: InlineGristGlobal
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Shape of the synthesised global. Matches `globalThis.grist` from `grist-global.d.ts`.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: parseDocument
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Checks a replica document and returns it, or throws naming each problem's path.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: presets
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Useful templates for quick demos and tests.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator.name: resolveMappings
grist-widget-sdk/emulator.summary: Resolves the `mappings` payload that `CustomSectionAPI.mappings()` returns.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator/testing.name: renderWithGrist
grist-widget-sdk/emulator/testing.summary: Renders a component against an in-memory Grist (the emulator), behind the same `grist` global a widget reads in Grist. With `widget`, it renders the widget in its provider, boundary and alerts, every declared column mapped to a table of `rows`: `renderWithGrist(<App />, { widget, rows })`.

grist-widget-sdk/emulator/testing.name: smokeTestWidget
grist-widget-sdk/emulator/testing.summary: Mounts the widget the way `mountGristWidget()` does inside Grist, against an emulated Grist document with every column it declares mapped and the access it requests granted, and waits until it renders past `GristBoundary`. Resolves once it has, rejects with the widget's own error if it throws, or with what the page showed instead if it never gets there. Then unmounts.
